name: style-simple
description: CSS Library with an easy syntax that is simple to use

scripts.build: sass src/main.scss dist/css/style-simple.css & sass --style=compressed src/main.scss dist/css/style-simple.min.css
scripts.watch: sass --watch src/main.scss dist/css/style-simple.css & sass --watch --style=compressed src/main.scss dist/css/style-simple.min.css
